pages.text: The $(item)Large Wild Skyseed$() — a Wild Skyseed packed round with a jumble of $(bold)wood, sand, water and dirt$(), because it could grow into anything. A $(bold)large$() island of whatever biome it lands over.
Ring the base Wild Skyseed with planks, sand, kelp and dirt.
The same adapt-to-the-biome trick at the larger tier — radius 13–17, a deeper ore-rich core — with room for the bigger buildings a small isle can't host, when the ~1-in-20 roll lands one.
